newsitem.title: MEXICO: BMW says Mexico '96 output will triple.
newsitem.headline: BMW says Mexico '96 output will triple.

text.p: Production by BMW's Mexican arm will have increased threefold by the close of 1996 from year-ago figures, a company director said on Wednesday.
"We do not know the exact figure (for domestic production), but we closed last year with 300 (units) and will close this year with more than 1,000," said BMW's Mexico director Frantz van Garner.
Garner said BMW did not just produce cars in Mexico, but also manufactured components and spare parts, most of which were exported.
"We will close the year with over $80 million (in exports), which is just the beginning, considering we were doing nothing in Mexico two years ago," he added.
BMW began production in Mexico in August 1995 at a plant in Toluca, some 60 kilometers west of Mexico City.
